controls.name: C-7d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-19T08:52:52.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-19T09:52:52.000Z"
  AND host.name == "db-1"
  AND process.name == "sshd"
  AND event.outcome == "failure"
  AND message LIKE "*Failed password*"
| KEEP @timestamp, source.ip, source.port, user.name, message
| SORT @timestamp ASC
| LIMIT 100
